raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `Dockerfile.rocm`, `run-amd-test.sh`: the test image installs `amd_ci_fast_exit.py` into site-packages, so jobs no longer copy it in at start
- `check-ray-compatibility.sh`: strip the stack's local pins (TheRock torch, triton, amdsmi) on every ROCm torch, not only when download.pytorch.org has no `rocm<ver>` index

The ray-compat check only passes today because TheRock torch reports HIP 7.15 and download.pytorch.org has no `rocm7.15` index ([build 15532](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15532)); once that index appears, the check would keep the `+rocm` pins and fail to resolve. The test image already has `.buildkite/`, so installing the pytest plugin there replaces the copy every job made, and #63426 also edits `run-amd-test.sh` around it. Follow-up to #61939; `pytest tests/tools/test_rocm_build.py tests/tools/test_amd_ci_fast_exit.py` passes, but none of this has run in AMD CI yet.

An earlier revision also worked around the AITER nightly lane's image-build failure; that is dropped, since the nightlies are now `manylinux_2_28` and pass the existing ldd check ([build 15765](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15765)).

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

- `check-ray-compatibility.sh`: strip the stack's local pins (TheRock torch, triton, amdsmi) on every ROCm torch, not only when download.pytorch.org has no `rocm<ver>` index

The test image already has `.buildkite/`, so installing the pytest plugin there replaces the copy every job made, and #63426 also edits `run-amd-test.sh` around it. Follow-up to #61939; `pytest tests/tools/test_rocm_build.py tests/tools/test_amd_ci_fast_exit.py` passes, but none of this has run in AMD CI yet.

An earlier revision also worked around the AITER nightly lane's image-build failure; that is dropped, since the nightlies are now `manylinux_2_28` and pass the existing ldd check ([build 15765](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15765)).

files.patch:
@@ -20,15 +20,16 @@ trap 'rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"' EXIT
 
 if python3 -c "import torch; assert torch.version.hip" 2>/dev/null; then
     ROCM_VER=$(python3 -c "import torch; print(torch.version.hip.rsplit('.', 1)[0])")
+    # The image's own stack builds (TheRock torch, triton, amdsmi) are on no public index,
+    # download.pytorch.org's rocm<ver> one included.
+    LOCAL_BUILDS=1
     CANDIDATE_URL="https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm${ROCM_VER}"
     if curl -fsSL --head "${CANDIDATE_URL}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
         TORCH_INDEX_URL="${CANDIDATE_URL}"
     else
         echo ">>> WARNING: ROCm ${ROCM_VER} wheel index not found at ${CANDIDATE_URL}"
         echo ">>>          Falling back to default PyPI (resolution may be incomplete)"
         TORCH_INDEX_URL=""
-        # The image's own stack builds (TheRock torch, triton, amdsmi) are on no public index.
-        LOCAL_BUILDS=1
     fi
 else
     if [ "${TORCH_NIGHTLY:-0}" = "1" ]; then

@@ -76,12 +76,8 @@ export PYTEST_ADDOPTS="${PYTEST_ADDOPTS:-} \
   --timeout-method=thread"
 
 # After its summary, a pytest process leaves without native library teardown, where it
-# has crashed with SIGSEGV after every test passed (amd_ci_fast_exit.py).
-# Installed into site-packages, not put on PYTHONPATH: commands that set PYTHONPATH themselves
-# still inherit PYTEST_ADDOPTS and must find the plugin.
-ci_dir=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
-cp "$ci_dir/amd_ci_fast_exit.py" \
-  "$(python3 -P -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')/" || exit 1
+# has crashed with SIGSEGV after every test passed (amd_ci_fast_exit.py, which the test image
+# installs into site-packages so that commands setting their own PYTHONPATH still find it).
 export PYTEST_ADDOPTS="$PYTEST_ADDOPTS -p amd_ci_fast_exit"
 
 [[ $gpus == 0 ]] && export VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu

@@ -581,6 +581,9 @@ COPY --link --exclude=vllm --exclude=.git . /vllm-workspace/
 # Source under src/ so it does not shadow the installed package in tests.
 COPY --link vllm /vllm-workspace/src/vllm
 WORKDIR /vllm-workspace
+# run-amd-test.sh's pytest plugin, in site-packages: commands that set PYTHONPATH still load it.
+RUN cp .buildkite/scripts/hardware_ci/amd_ci_fast_exit.py \
+    "$(python3 -P -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')/"
 
 FROM test AS test-smoke
 RUN --network=none python3 -c "import vllm, vllm._C, vllm._rocm_C; print(vllm.__version__)"
